title: Mechanism of production and deviation from the standard Gutenberg-Richter law of the big earthquakes (An analysis of big earthquakes)
summary: We describe two self-replicating mechanisms of energy accumulation in the seismic focus, which modify the Gutenberg-Richter law in the region of the big earthquakes. The first mechanism acts for magnitudes smaller than a narrow region of large critical magnitudes; it slows down the energy accumulation and may produce precursors. The second mechanism acts above that region, and accelerates the energy accumulation; the precursors may be absent. Both mechanisms reduce the Gutenberg-Richter excedence distribution.
